claim: The frozen theta_repair is globally maximal on [0,1] among coherence values with spectral radius at most 0.98 for the sealed operator.
argument: At lambda=-0.98, the rank-two matrix determinant lemma reduces det(P(theta)+0.98 I) to det(A) det(I-theta K). The only root in [0,1] is theta_repair; the other root is negative. At theta=0 the complete spectrum lies inside radius 0.98 and det(A)>0. After the simple root the determinant is negative and cannot change sign again. Complex-conjugate factors contribute positively, so for every theta>theta_repair at least one real eigenvalue is below -0.98 and the spectral radius exceeds 0.98.
authority: post-confirmatory theorem strengthening using only frozen operator and path; no tuning
